reviews.review_text:
John Li
Hai Phong, Vietnam18 contributions

Good
Oct 2026 • Friends
A Japanese restaurant by West Lake in Hanoi that is very worth visiting, with a great environment and atmosphere, especially suitable for dates or friends' gatherings. The overall decoration is exquisite, the view is open, and the service is quite detailed. The ingredients of the sushi and teppanyaki are fresh, the presentation is beautiful, and the overall taste is good; they don't overdo it to look "high-end." The scenery of West Lake combined with the restaurant atmosphere makes it very suitable for a leisurely meal. The price is not cheap, but the overall experience is good considering the environment, food, and service; I will consider coming back to Hanoi next time.
Waiter Quan, Chef Tuan very good and nice.#restaurant #japanese

I was served by Quan on both evenings, and he was extremely attentive, friendly and professional. He made both visits feel very welcoming.
Highly recommend Mizumi if you’re looking for excellent Japanese food in Hanoi.
